title: Light board, date bands and date filter
author: claude
summary: Light grey board, one band per day so it is easy to see what was done when, a date filter, and no minimap.
what: Board background is plain light grey. Under the topic headers each day is its own horizontal band with a line and a big date label. Toolbar has Today / Last 7 days / All dates chips and From-To pickers; cards outside the range fade. Minimap and the React Flow credit link removed.
why: The user found the dark board hard to read and wanted to separate work by date.
how: model.ts now places steps by hand into date bands under the dagre-placed headers; bands are background nodes. filters.ts gained from/to. Saved card positions got a version number so old ones are ignored.
beforeText: Dark board, no dates on the board, minimap in the corner.
afterText: Light board, one band per day, date filter, no minimap.
wrong: The store was stripping the new layout version field on load and save; fixed in devlog/store.mjs.

images.caption: Test run with dates shifted to show four day bands
